title: GET (Graduate Engineer Trainee)
description: Designation: Graduate Engineer Trainee (Shift Operator) We are looking for Graduate Engineer Trainees (Shift Operators) . Freshers are welcome to apply. This role provides an opportunity to develop hands-on technical expertise in water treatment plant operations, maintenance, documentation, and operator competency. Key Responsibilities Ensure adherence to industrial safety practices during all plant operations and maintenance activities. Operate and monitor pre-treatment, water generation, storage, and distribution systems as per prescribed SOPs. Ensure optimal and safe operation of all plant equipment. Perform assigned site administrative activities, including HR compliance, documentation, invoicing, payment follow-up, and other related responsibilities. Follow all applicable SOPs, safety procedures, quality requirements, and customer/site guidelines. Eligibility Diploma in Engineering – Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical / Instrumentation / relevant discipline. Freshers are welcome to apply. Candidates with experience in DM / RO / Purified Water Systems / Utility Operations & Maintenance will also be considered. Willingness to work in shift operations and site environments. Good learning attitude, discipline, and willingness to develop technical and operational skills.
